scope: Manual browser shell UI inspection with tools/preview_shell.py and a synthetic ForgeNative adapter. This does not verify Android startup, native rendering, IME, real file I/O or persistence.

checks.test: Shell boot opens the fixture C++ tab
Russian settings expose indentation, tab width, file encoding and smart block formatting
English settings and encoding dialog are translated
Selecting Tabs and applying changes displays Tabs: 4 in the status bar
No Russian title, aria-label or placeholder attributes remain in the English fixture shell
No Russian static leaf labels remain outside excluded code, output and language/file-name fields
GNU standards display as GNU C++17 and GNU C11 rather than omitting C
